title: Older `Core` reference cards are not yet written in the plain voice.
text: `rule:core-api/reference-card` holds every card to `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*, because a hover and `nvs help` print it. Cards written before that rule remain in another voice, for example `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/objset.rs:157` ("holds"), `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/objset.rs:185` ("drops") and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs:623` ("drops the remainder"). No session sweeps them: a card is rewritten when its class is next touched, and this record is deleted when no card in the old voice is left.
